legal.how.s1.title: One home, one phone
legal.how.s1.body: v1 is built for a single household on a single iPhone. Your rooms, chores, and restock list live on this device. Sharing across phones is not in this version.
legal.how.s2.title: Today is the list
legal.how.s2.body: Today shows what is due now, what is still open, and what to order. Completing a chore records it on this phone. Nothing syncs to a server.
legal.how.s3.title: Restock is when to buy
legal.how.s3.body: Filters, batteries, and pads get an order-by date. You check out at the store. Paste a product link if you want a shortcut back to the listing.
legal.how.s4.title: Seasonal lives on Today
legal.how.s4.body: A ZIP sets your climate zone on device. Apple Weather fills the forecast. Seasonal checklists show up on Today when they matter for this house, with the full year one tap away.
legal.how.s5.title: Forecast lives on Home
legal.how.s5.body: Replacement forecast sits on Home next to your rooms and appliances. Open it when you want the full Budget timeline.
legal.how.s6.title: Moving to a new iPhone
legal.how.s6.body: Your home stays on this iPhone. Face ID or your device passcode unlocks it. To move to a new phone, create a backup password file in Settings and restore it there. Cuidala cannot recover a forgotten backup password. Deleting the app removes your home from this iPhone. Erase everything also removes the device key.
legal.privacy.whatBody: Cuidala is a household maintenance app. It keeps a list of your rooms, chores, appliances, and the consumables you need to reorder, and tells you when to order them. v1 is one home on one iPhone, sold on the US App Store.
legal.privacy.storedBody: Everything you enter (home name, rooms, chores, notes, appliance details, consumables, completion history, your ZIP code, and the settings you choose) is stored only on your iPhone. It is encrypted at rest with a key held in the iOS Keychain, unlocked with Face ID or your device passcode. That key stays on this iPhone and does not travel with iCloud backup. Use the backup password file in Settings to move your home to a new phone. Cuidala has no user accounts and no servers that receive this data.
legal.privacy.weatherBody: Forecasts come from Apple WeatherKit on this iPhone. Your ZIP or coordinates are sent to Apple for geocoding and WeatherKit. Cuidala itself never receives that data and has no weather servers.
legal.privacy.retailerBody: When you tap Order or Find it, the retailer’s website opens in an in-app Safari view. What you do there is governed by that retailer’s policy. Cuidala does not place orders, see what you buy, or store payment information.
legal.privacy.completeList: That is the complete list. Cuidala does not use analytics, advertising, or crash-reporting services.
legal.privacy.labelBody: Data Not Collected. WeatherKit and geocoding requests go to Apple, not to Cuidala. Your chores stay on this iPhone.
legal.privacy.locBody: Used during setup to pick seasonal tasks and to request Apple Weather. ZIP can be typed instead.
legal.privacy.notifBody: Local reminders scheduled on your device for restock dates and a weekly digest. You can hide item names on the lock screen in Settings.
legal.privacy.bioBody: Used to lock the app. Biometric data never leaves the Secure Enclave and is not available to Cuidala.
legal.privacy.deleteBody: Deleting the app removes your home from this iPhone. The Keychain key is removed by Erase everything in Settings, not by deleting the app. Scheduled reminders go away with the app. Because nothing is stored elsewhere, there is nothing else to delete.
legal.privacy.childrenBody: Cuidala is not directed at children under 13 and does not knowingly collect information from them.
legal.privacy.contactBody: If this policy changes, the new version ships with an app update and the effective date above changes. Questions:
legal.terms.p1: These additional terms apply to Cuidala on the App Store. Apple’s Standard EULA also applies, as set in App Store Connect.
legal.terms.p2: Cuidala is for a single household on a single iPhone in the United States.
legal.terms.p3: Cuidala helps you organise home maintenance. Reminders, seasonal checklists, cost forecasts, and replacement estimates are informational only. They are generated from what you enter and from national typical figures, 2026. They are not professional advice. Always follow manufacturer instructions and local codes, and consult a qualified professional for electrical, gas, structural, roof, pest, or safety-related work.
legal.terms.p4: Retailer links open third-party websites. Purchases are made with the retailer under its terms; Cuidala is not a party to those transactions and receives no commission or data from them.
legal.terms.p5: Your data lives on your device. To move your home to a new iPhone, use the backup password file in Settings. Cuidala cannot recover data from a lost device or a forgotten backup password.
legal.terms.p6: The app is provided “as is” without warranty of any kind. To the extent permitted by law, Cuidala is not liable for consequential, incidental, special, or lost-profit damages, and liability is limited to the amount you paid for the app.
legal.terms.p7: These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Arizona, USA. Venue is in Pima County, Arizona. Questions:

content.playbook.all-safety.name: Whole-home safety
content.playbook.new-home.name: New Home
content.playbook.hot-arid-presummer.name: Pre-summer AC service
content.playbook.hot-arid-presummer.why: AC techs book solid by May. A tune-up now costs a service call; a July failure costs emergency rates and a brutal wait.
content.playbook.hot-arid-monsoon.name: Monsoon prep
content.playbook.hot-arid-monsoon.why: Monsoon storms arrive fast. Clear drainage and secured loose items prevent the most common summer damage claims.
content.playbook.hot-arid-post-monsoon.w: Monsoon debris left on roofs and in gutters bakes in and causes leaks the following summer.
content.playbook.hot-arid-cooler.name: Evaporative cooler startup
content.playbook.hot-arid-cooler.why: Fresh pads and a clean reservoir before first heat — mid-season startup problems always land on the hottest week.
An un-winterized cooler grows scale and mineral damage over winter and shortens pad and pump life.
content.playbook.hot-arid-irrigation.why: Summer watering needs change fast in the desert. A seasonal adjustment saves water and keeps plants alive through June.
content.playbook.hot-arid-dust-hvac.name: Dust-season HVAC filter
content.playbook.hot-arid-dust-hvac.why: Spring dust loads filters in a week. A clean filter before the first 100° day is cheaper than a service call.
content.playbook.hot-arid-uv.name: UV caulk and paint inspection
content.playbook.hot-arid-uv.why: Desert UV destroys caulk and paint faster than anywhere else. Small touch-ups now prevent stucco and window leaks.
content.playbook.mixed-ac-service.name: Spring AC tune-up
content.playbook.mixed-ac-service.why: First 90° week arrives fast. A spring tune-up and fresh filter beat a mid-June service wait.
content.playbook.mixed-furnace.name: Fall heat inspection
content.playbook.mixed-furnace.why: First freeze is when heat fails. An inspection and filter change in fall is cheaper than an emergency call.
content.playbook.mixed-gutters.name: Fall gutter clearing
content.playbook.mixed-gutters.why: Leaf-clogged gutters overflow into the foundation and freeze into ice dams.
content.playbook.mixed-hose-bibs.name: Disconnect hoses
content.playbook.mixed-hose-bibs.why: A connected hose can freeze and crack the spigot or the pipe inside the wall.
content.playbook.mixed-humidity.name: Summer humidity check
content.playbook.mixed-humidity.why: Basement humidity above 50% grows mold and rusts ductwork.
content.playbook.mixed-sump.name: Spring sump test
content.playbook.mixed-sump.why: Spring rains find dead sump pumps. A bucket test is ten minutes.
content.playbook.mixed-termite.name: Spring termite walk
content.playbook.mixed-termite.why: Mud tubes and wood-to-soil contact are early signs. Catching them in spring is cheaper than structural repair.
content.playbook.mixed-storm.name: Storm limb check
content.playbook.mixed-storm.why: Limbs over the roof and lines come down in summer storms. Trim before peak season.
content.playbook.cold-furnace.name: Furnace service
content.playbook.cold-furnace.why: Furnace techs book out once the first cold snap hits. A fall service is the cheapest insurance against a mid-winter failure.
content.playbook.cold-winterize.name: Winterize outdoor water
content.playbook.cold-winterize.why: One hard freeze with a connected hose can split a pipe inside the wall. Ten minutes now prevents a four-figure repair.
content.playbook.cold-gutters.name: Fall gutter cleaning
content.playbook.cold-gutters.why: Leaf-clogged gutters cause ice dams that force water under shingles all winter.
content.playbook.cold-chimney.name: Chimney inspection
content.playbook.cold-chimney.why: Creosote buildup is the leading cause of chimney fires. Inspect before the first fire of the season.
content.playbook.cold-snow.name: Snow equipment prep
content.playbook.cold-snow.why: Snow equipment fails the first time you need it. Fuel, oil, and a test run before the first storm.
content.playbook.cold-sump.name: Spring sump pump test
content.playbook.cold-sump.why: Spring melt is when sump pumps fail. A test now beats discovering a dead pump with water rising.
content.playbook.cold-hose-bibs.name: Drain exterior spigots
content.playbook.cold-hose-bibs.why: A hose left on a bib can freeze and crack the valve inside the wall.
content.playbook.cold-attic.name: Attic insulation check
content.playbook.cold-attic.why: Thin attic insulation and poor ventilation are the usual ice-dam setup before snow.
content.playbook.cold-humidifier.name: Humidifier pad cleaning
content.playbook.cold-humidifier.why: Dirty humidifier pads grow mold and push it through the ducts all winter.
content.playbook.cold-spring-thaw.name: Spring thaw walk
content.playbook.cold-spring-thaw.why: Thaw reveals grading problems and foundation cracks that freeze hid all winter.
content.playbook.cold-ac-startup.name: AC condenser startup
content.playbook.cold-ac-startup.why: Debris in the condenser and a first-run failure are common after a long off season.
content.playbook.cold-window-seal.name: Window weatherstrip check
content.playbook.cold-window-seal.why: Leaky windows and doors waste heat and create ice on the glass.
content.playbook.humid-hurricane.name: Hurricane prep
content.playbook.humid-hurricane.why: Season runs June through November. Supplies and a plan before the first named storm — stores empty out fast.
content.playbook.humid-mold.name: Dehumidifier and mold checks
content.playbook.humid-mold.why: Humidity season feeds mold in weeks. Dehumidifier checks now prevent remediation bills later.
content.playbook.humid-termite.name: Termite inspection
content.playbook.humid-termite.why: Spring swarm season is when infestations start. An annual inspection is a fraction of treatment cost.
content.playbook.humid-ac-drain.name: AC drain line flush
content.playbook.humid-ac-drain.why: A clogged AC drain line backs condensate into the ceiling. A cup of vinegar now beats a drywall repair.
content.playbook.marine-moss.name: Moss and gutter management
content.playbook.marine-moss.why: Wet season feeds roof moss that lifts shingles. Treat before the rains set in.
content.playbook.marine-roof.name: Post-storm roof inspection
content.playbook.marine-roof.why: Winter storms loosen flashing and shingles. A spring check catches damage while it is still small.
content.playbook.marine-wood.name: Exterior wood sealing
content.playbook.marine-wood.why: Exterior wood only seals well when dry. The summer window is short — miss it and decks absorb a whole wet season.
